cells.gaps: No share or count of primary clinics entering their own reports has been found; the 92 per cent in MRT-016 is report coverage, with no numerator or denominator, and MRT-011's 'deployed nationally' (2025) is not facility entry and disagrees with MRT-017 (2023), which has DHIS2 piloted and not scaled up. Health posts report on paper, only two hospitals are integrated (MRT-010), and the one event in the twelve months is a training workshop for district focal points (MRT-008).
cells.note: DHIS2 is keyed at the moughataa and district level from the health posts' paper reports, which is the stage 3 row in full. Stage 4 needs entry at the facility and more than half of primary clinics entering their own reports, and neither is evidenced.

cells.gaps: The only record shown in use is one pilot health centre, Sebkha, on a fact dated 2022, with nothing later on whether it still runs; the 12 OpenClinic GA pilot sites confirmed in October 2026 (MRT-025) await a first deployment. Where the record is digitised is not stated, and no finance or plan is dated in the 36 months.
cells.note: Electronic records are in one pilot centre and a pilot of 12 health centres is being prepared: pilot facilities, the stage 2 row. Stage 3 needs most hospitals or primary clinics in some districts using records, and no source shows that.
